scenarios.command: three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall are filed at http://127.0.0.1:38955/recall-brief. for each explanation, read its dossier and the independent lab report it links, then tell me which explanation the lab evidence supports, with the measurement it rests on, and say what ruled out each of the other two

args.headline: Weigh three recall explanations against lab evidence
args.objective: Read the recall brief at 127.0.0.1:38955/recall-brief, open each of the three explanations' dossiers and their linked independent lab reports, and determine which explanation the lab measurements support, citing the decisive measurement and what ruled out the other two.

args.observation: Independent lab report on the ceramic coating cure theory: cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch — theory NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.observation: Independent lab report on the bearing seat machining theory: bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize — theory SUPPORTED.
args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.

args.observation: Independent lab report on the packaging compression theory: packaging matched spec on every recalled batch — theory NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

actions.name: record_candidate
actions.error: record_candidate rejected (unknown_candidate): no Candidate 'memory-8' exists in this Session — cite the identity its record_candidate call returned.

args.detail: Bearing seats machined 0.4 mm undersize on every recalled batch; coating cure and packaging theories measured within spec.
args.subject: Bearing seat machining as the lab-supported explanation for the Q3 fixture widget recall

metrics.answerText:
**Verdict: the lab evidence supports the bearing seat machining theory.**

**The measurement it rests on:** Bearing seats on **every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize** — [lab report for bearing seat machining](http://127.0.0.2:40441/lab-bearing)

**What ruled out the other two:**
- **Ceramic coating cure** — coating cure times were **within tolerance on every recalled batch** — [lab report](http://127.0.0.2:40441/lab-coating)
- **Packaging compression** — packaging **matched spec on every recalled batch** — [lab report](http://127.0.0.2:40441/lab-packaging)

Each dossier (coating, bearing, packaging) on its own stated no verdict and deferred to its independent lab report; all three lab reports were read directly. Exactly one came back supported, consistent with the brief's claim.
